map.Q = K·tⁿ（n≤0.45 Fick扩散，0.45<n<0.89 混合机制）: Q = K*t^n (n<=0.45 Fick diffusion, 0.45<n<0.89 mixed mechanism)
Drug loading A = 10 mg/cm3, effective diffusion D = 1e-7 cm2/h, thickness h = 0.1 cm, t = 6 h: Q = 10 x sqrt(1e-7x6/0.1) = 10 x 0.002449 = 0.0245 mg/cm2; K = Q/sqrt(t) = 0.0100, and the 6 h release rate is 0.0245 over the total drug amount.
map.dQ/dt=K/(2√t)=0.0100/(2×√6)=0.00204 mg/c: dQ/dt = K/(2*sqrt(t)) = 0.0100/(2 x sqrt(6)) = 0.00204 mg/cm2/h, decreasing over time (the sqrt(t) law).
